news.title: Chainalysis Used AI to Trace the $387M Bitget Hack Back to North Korea
news.summary: The firm says the Sept. 24 breach pushed North Korea's 2026 crypto haul past $1 billion, and detailed how it used in-house AI to trace the stolen funds across four blockchains in a race against the attackers.
